case.final_message:
Your plan change was recorded on 16 March 2026, moving you from Pro at 49.00 per month to Basic at 19.00 per month.

Under the pricing policy, downgrades take effect from the next billing cycle, while upgrades are prorated daily. Because your downgrade fell mid-cycle, March remained on the Pro rate of 49.00, and the Basic rate of 19.00 applied from April onward.

This is the only record I could confirm for your request; it reflects the policy as applied. If you believe the timing was different, reply and we can look further.
